Assistant (23.3s): That does not match our records. What is your date of birth?

User (25.2s): I'm getting really frustrated with this system because I'm trying to get things done before my next meeting. It's twenty-one July nineteen ninety, and honestly, can you just tell me how much I owe?

Assistant (29.2s): I am sorry, I could not verify your identity, so I cannot continue on this call. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
